CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified, its presentation as coordinate set is given, and an origin/status field for the same item is present.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking processing or allocation to the identified content's presentation or access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content tokens (red/blue) are identified with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are provided separately from content coordinate assignments, distinguishing content identity from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report states how content is presented (coordinate sets) and gives an explicit layout rule.
